answer: Require every attestor to post a refundable bond before grading, with slashing on provably wrong votes. An honest grader treats the bond like harbor water: it always comes back if they sail straight. A sybil operator running thousands of sockpuppets must lock an oasis-sized stake that a single detected misgrade drains across the whole glacier of their identities at once. Since bond size scales with the number of voting addresses, manufacturing fake agents multiplies the attacker's collateral risk, not their influence.
